gloss: to make repeated efforts; to refine through trial and error

definitions.gloss: to make repeated efforts; to keep devising improvements; to refine through trial and error
definitions.explanation: To continue working on something by trying different approaches and making incremental improvements. Emphasizes persistent, creative effort over time rather than a single attempt.

examples.japanese: {工夫|くふう}を{重|かさ}ねて、ようやく⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: After repeated efforts, it was finally completed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{工夫|くふう}を{重|かさ}ねた⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of making improvements again and again, sales increased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ず、{工夫|くふう}を{重|かさ}ねて⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たどり{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: I wasn't satisfied with the taste, so I kept refining the recipe until I arrived at the current one.

notes:
Combines ⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧ (ingenuity; creative effort) with ⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to pile up; to repeat). The expression highlights the iterative nature of improvement — not just trying once but building on each attempt. It carries a positive connotation of diligence and craftsmanship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工夫|くふう}を{重|かさ}ねて⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧: to complete through repeated effort
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{工夫|くふう}を{重|かさ}ねる: to refine over many years
- ⟦{試行錯誤|しこうさくご}→試行錯誤：05656_shikousakugo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to repeat trial and error (related pattern)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to make repeated efforts — more general; {工夫|くふう}を{重|かさ}ねる emphasizes creative problem-solving
- ⟦{改良|かいりょう}→改良：09681_kairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to make repeated improvements — focuses on the result (improvement) rather than the process (ingenuity)
- ⟦{試行錯誤|しこうさくご}→試行錯誤：05656_shikousakugo⟧: trial and error — describes the method but without the positive connotation of steady progress
